trans-unit.source: Brand colors (reload the backend after saving)

Primary color: Main accent for buttons, links, focus and active states. In the Fresh theme the top bar and module menu are derived from it. Only hue and saturation are used, lightness is set by the theme. Leave empty to use the theme default.
Secondary color: Used for secondary buttons and badges. Leave empty to derive it from the primary color.
Icon accent color: Accent part of the core icons, including the module menu. Leave empty to use the theme default.
Background color: Background of the top bar. Used exactly as entered. Leave empty to use the theme default.
Text color: Text and icon color in the top bar. Make sure it contrasts with the background. Leave empty to use the theme default.
Background color: Background of the module menu on the left. Used exactly as entered. Leave empty to use the theme default.
Text color: Text color in the module menu. Make sure it contrasts with the background. Leave empty to use the theme default.
Neutral tint (%): How strongly grey surfaces pick up the primary color. Whole number from 0 to 100. Theme defaults are Modern 8, Fresh 12, Classic 0. Leave empty to use the theme default.

State color harmonization (%): How strongly success, info, warning and danger colors pick up the primary color. Whole number from 0 to 100. Theme defaults are Modern and Fresh 5, Classic 0. Leave empty to use the theme default.
